title: Gittensory MCP tool leaks miner financial data via missing contributor-scoped access control
summary: @jsonbored/gittensory-mcp (npm) through 0.1.0: the gittensory_get_contributor_profile MCP tool (and the matching GET /v1/contributors/:login/profile endpoint) skips the contributor-scoped access check enforced by every sibling endpoint — any authenticated session/API/MCP token holder can read any contributor's profile, exposing miner earnings data (alphaPerDay, taoPerDay, usdPerDay). Patched upstream (commit 811ef5f); no fixed npm release was available at publication.
